description: 12,000-record pseudonymous academic indicator dataset with independent non-circular ground-truth labels and isolated demographic attributes.
source_citation: Synthetic academic decision-support benchmark generated algorithmically for the SC03 Capstone Project. The Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD; Kuzilek, Hlosta & Zdrahal, 2017) is cited strictly as conceptual and architectural design inspiration for indicator naming and telemetry schemas, not as an empirical data source. No real student observations were accessed, downloaded, or used.
licence: MIT License (Synthetic Capstone Benchmark - Educational Decision Support)
synthetic_nature_notice: All 12,000 academic records and ground-truth risk labels are 100% synthetic, generated via parametric latent factor simulation. They are not real student observations. Evaluation on labels generated from the same simulated feature rules demonstrates model mechanics and non-linear learning capacity, but does not establish real-world intervention performance.
test_fixture_note: data/raw/student_performance_raw.csv (12,005 rows) is a synthetically generated raw test fixture containing 5 duplicate rows and 60 missing values deliberately injected to test and validate pipeline deduplication and median imputation routines; it is not an original source record file.

generator_and_label_rules.latent_factors: A ~ N(0, 1) (Academic Aptitude), W ~ N(0, 1) (Work Ethic)

column_mapping.attendance_pct: Classroom attendance percentage (conceptual analogue of OULAD active-days proxy)
column_mapping.assessment_pct: Continuous internal assessment percentage (conceptual analogue of OULAD TMA analogue)
column_mapping.assignment_pct: Homework and laboratory assignment percentage (conceptual analogue of OULAD CMA analogue)
column_mapping.engagement_score: LMS portal engagement activity on 0.0-10.0 scale (conceptual analogue of OULAD VLE clicks log-scaled)
column_mapping.risk_label: Target intervention classification: low, medium, high

proxy_flags.attendance_pct: Simulated attendance tracking proxy (conceptual analogue of OULAD active-days)

protected_attributes_policy: TR-014: Demographic columns (gender, age_band, disability, socio_economic_decile) are stored exclusively in protected_attributes.csv and NEVER joined into model features. Reserved strictly for the Step 7 fairness and bias audit.

label_leakage_check.explanation: Baseline accuracy is 78.3% (strictly non-circular). Linear baseline formula encounters natural errors on boundary and non-linear interaction cases (e.g. high engagement with weak assessment), providing legitimate comparative headroom for neural classifiers.
